action.instructions: In this racing game, which single input should the driver apply right now?

criteria.accelerate: Accelerate on a straight or gentle section when nothing blocks the racing line.
criteria.brake: Brake before a sharp corner or when entering it too fast would crash.
criteria.steer_left: Steer left to follow the corner or avoid an obstacle on the right.
criteria.steer_right: Steer right to follow the corner or avoid an obstacle on the left.
criteria.boost: Use boost on a long clear straight when boost is available.

danger.instructions: How likely is a crash or a big loss of time in the next second without correction?
